mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET last_message_id = #{messageId}, last_message_content = #{content}, last_message_time = now() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id AS conversationId, c.conversation_type AS conversationType, CASE WHEN last_msg.status = 1 THEN '[消息已撤回]' WHEN last_msg.status = 2 THEN '[消息已删除]' WHEN last_msg.message_type = 2 THEN '[图片]' ELSE c.last_message_content END AS lastMessage, c.last_message_time AS lastMessageTime, cm.unread_count AS unreadCount, cm.is_muted AS isMuted, cm.is_top AS isTop, -- 单聊时获取对方信息 other_cm.user_id AS otherUserId, u.nick_name AS otherUserName, u.avatar AS otherUserAvatar FROM conversation c INNER JOIN conversation_member cm ON c.conversation_id = cm.conversation_id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.is_deleted = 0 -- 关联对方成员（单聊） LEFT JOIN conversation_member other_cm ON c.conversation_id = other_cm.conversation_id AND other_cm.user_id != #{userId} AND c.conversation_type = 1 -- 关联对方用户信息 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON other_cm.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN message last_msg ON last_msg.message_id = c.last_message_id ORDER BY cm.is_top DESC, c.last_message_time DESC

SELECT c.conversation_id FROM conversation c INNER JOIN conversation_member cm1 ON c.conversation_id = cm1.conversation_id AND cm1.user_id = #{userId1} INNER JOIN conversation_member cm2 ON c.conversation_id = cm2.conversation_id AND cm2.user_id = #{userId2} WHERE c.conversation_type = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation WHERE conversation_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
